identification: Acrylic of Australian bush with kangaroos, spotted-tailed quolls, little owl and sugar glider, signed lower right in block letters 'M. McWILLIAMS 1997' (read from enlarged photo 3). Likely Michael McWilliams (b.1956, Launceston), Glover Prize winner 2004, who paints animals in Tasmanian landscapes and made small 1997 acrylics (e.g. Pied Oyster Catchers, Flying Gull). The scene is tidier and more naturalistic than his usual satirical work, so attribution is not confirmed; the Australia Post stamp claim in the scan notes was not found.
